name: Witness Flame
description: Kindles a steady sacred light that reveals spiritual corruption, desecration, hidden altars, and nearby malign residue.

name: Merciful Touch
description: Channels restorative grace through touch to close minor wounds, steady pain, and ease fatigue or panic.

name: Quiet the Heart
description: Settles fear, grief, frenzy, and spiritual agitation, making the target harder to break, intimidate, or provoke.

name: Rite of Purification
description: Cleanses food, drink, flesh, tools, or a small space of mundane spoilage, minor poison, and low spiritual contamination.

name: Hallow Mark
description: Places a sign of sanctified intent on a person, object, or threshold, making it easier to recognize, protect, or ritually defend.

name: Pilgrim's Grace
description: Blesses a traveler or group against illness, dread, foul air, and minor misfortune during a journey.

name: Halo Ward
description: Wraps a target in a soft aura that weakens curses, necrotic influence, and hostile spiritual intrusion.

name: Rebuke the Unclean
description: Projects holy force that staggers undead, fiends, possessed beings, and spiritually corrupted entities.

name: Oath of Witness
description: Sanctifies a spoken oath, confession, or sworn office so that deliberate betrayal brings visible spiritual backlash.

name: Sanctuary Circle
description: Consecrates a defined zone where curses weaken, hostile spirits lose force, and allies recover composure and endurance.

name: Greater Intercession
description: Calls down a stronger healing current that restores serious injury, returns the dying from the edge, and mends deep exhaustion.

name: Dawn Judgment
description: Shapes concentrated sacred radiance into a decisive strike that scourges corruption while sparing the innocent where possible.

name: Temple Ground
description: Transforms a room, shrine, battlefield, or burial site into holy terrain that suppresses blight, fear, haunting, and profane workings.

name: Procession of Reckoning
description: Sends a rolling surge of sacred force through a scene, healing allies, exposing concealed evil, and breaking lesser malign enchantments.

name: Theophanic Miracle
description: The supreme sacred working: a vast eruption of grace, revelation, healing, and judgment that can cleanse a defiled place, break a regional curse, or restore hope to the broken.
